name: defibrillate_patient
description: Deliver electrical defibrillation for shockable cardiac rhythms (VF/pVT) following ACLS protocols

energy_level_joules.description: Energy level for shock delivery in joules

shock_number.description: Shock number in the current ACLS cycle (1, 2, 3, etc.)

rosc_achieved.description: Whether return of spontaneous circulation was achieved after shock

when_to_use: Ventricular fibrillation detected during cardiac arrest
Recurrent VF after initial ROSC requiring re-defibrillation
Peri-arrest patient with deteriorating to shockable rhythm

examples.query: Patient in VFib, delivering first biphasic shock at 120J
Second shock needed, VFib persists after first shock
